pr_title: [Performance](dsa_cp): recompute local_seq_lens for cpu to remove D2H
source_quote:
why do we cat a 0 here?
why not just maintain one `seq_lens_cpu`? This is confusing.

rule.description: 当代码中出现非直觉的 tensor 操作（如拼接零值、填充等）时，应添加注释说明操作的目的和原因，提高代码可读性。

antipattern.code:
def _build_local_query_lens_cpu(
    self,
    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
    num_reqs: int,
    local_rank: int,
    cp_size: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Compute local query lengths on CPU to avoid D2H sync."""
    query_start_loc_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu[:num_reqs + 1]
    local_query_lens = query_start_loc_cpu[1:] - query_start_loc_cpu[:-1]

    # Pad a zero to align with CPU-side sequence length computation
    # (the extra element corresponds to the sentinel entry in seq_lens)
    local_seq_lens = torch.cat(
        [local_query_lens, torch.tensor([0], device=local_query_lens.device)]
    )
    return local_seq_lens

def _build_local_query_lens_cpu(
    self,
    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
    num_reqs: int,
    local_rank: int,
    cp_size: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Compute local query lengths on CPU to avoid D2H sync."""
    query_start_loc_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu[:num_reqs + 1]
    local_query_lens = query_start_loc_cpu[1:] - query_start_loc_cpu[:-1]

    # Pad 0 to align with CPU-side seq length computation:
    # the extra element corresponds to the sentinel entry in seq_lens,
    # ensuring local_seq_lens has the same length as the device-side tensor.
    # Use new_zeros(1) to avoid allocating a new 1-element tensor from Python list
    # and to ensure dtype/device match. (Copilot suggestion)
    local_seq_lens = torch.cat(
        [local_query_lens, local_query_lens.new_zeros(1)]
    )
    return local_seq_lens
